test_schulze_method: test the Schulze method by verifying pairwise defeats, strongest path strengths, and social ranking against expected values
test_schulze_aggregate: test the Schulze aggregate method with different tie-breaking methods (RANDOM, TBRC) and seeds to validate untied rankings
test_for_fig_1: test the Schulze method on Figure 1 opinion and critique round examples from the paper
test_rank_compute_strongest_path_strengt: test that Schulze._compute_strongest_path_strengths raises ValueError for non-zero diagonal or wrong dimension inputs
test_rank_candidates: test that Schulze._rank_candidates raises ValueError for non-square or non-zero diagonal path strength inputs
